data.narrative:
Andromeda Surgical is a seed-stage biotech company founded by Nick Damiano and Kartik Tiwari that has raised $10M+. The valuation analysis draws from a universe of 3 public biotech & health comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Of the three valuation methods assessed, only stage-progression analysis proved applicable. This method uses the company's $35M total-raised proxy as a base value and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for seed-to-next-stage progression, yielding an implied valuation of $88M. Peer-median analysis could not be applied due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the biotech sector (fewer than 3 datapoints meeting narrow filters). Public-comp anchoring, while supported by a 6.2x P/S median across the three public tickers, cannot be executed without the target's revenue, which private companies typically do not disclose.

The single applicable method supports a triangulated range of $74M (low) to $101M (high), with a median of $88M. The primary uncertainty is methodological: reliance on a single approach limits confidence in the estimate. Revenue disclosure or identification of additional seed-stage biotech peers with disclosed metrics would strengthen the analysis substantially.
